stt.whisper_desc: Local Whisper runs on your machine.
stt.external_desc: External Whisper API (OpenAI-compatible). OpenAI and OpenRouter need an API key; a local server such as whisper.cpp may not.
stt.whisper_model_hint: Larger models are more accurate but slower.
stt.download_timeout: Download is taking longer than expected. Check the SkyrimNet logs.
stt.use_gpu_hint: Enable GPU acceleration for Whisper inference.
stt.cpu_threads_hint: Number of CPU threads to use for Whisper processing.
stt.use_finetune_hint: Use game-specific fine-tuned model if available.
stt.partial_results_hint: Enable real-time partial transcription results during recording.
stt.input_sample_rate_hint: Sample rate for raw PCM audio input.
stt.streaming_chunks_hint: Number of audio chunks to buffer for streaming transcription.
stt.silence_threshold_hint: Speech probability (0.0-1.0) at which the voice detector counts audio as speech, in your microphone and in NPC voice files.
stt.silence_duration_hint: Duration of silence required to end recording.
stt.open_mic_verbose_hint: Show notifications when Open Mic detects/sends speech.
stt.name_hints_hint: Tells speech recognition the names of nearby and pinned characters, you, and nearby places, so they come back spelled right. The stt_hints prompt sets what is sent.
stt.external_model_hint: Model name for the transcription API (e.g. openai/whisper-1 for OpenRouter; whisper-1 for OpenAI at https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions).
stt.test_no_result: No transcription received. Check microphone and STT configuration.
stt.fateless_desc: Speech-to-text on fateless.ai with your fateless.ai account. Requires an internet connection.
stt.fateless_streaming_hint: Sends your voice while you hold the key, once it hears you speak, so the text is ready moments after you let go. Costs a little more per minute. Quick taps, silent presses, languages Fateless cannot stream, and auto-detect use the normal upload.
stt.gpu_device_not_loaded: Device {{index}} (device list loads once speech-to-text has started)
voice_effects.page_desc: Create and preview voice-effect recipes that change how text-to-speech output sounds.
voice_effects.empty_select: Select an effect from the list, or create a new one.
voice_effects.saved_as: Saved as {{file}}. The id never changes after creation; renaming changes only the name.
voice_effects.shipped_hint: This recipe is shipped read-only. Saving writes your own copy over it; disable it here instead of deleting it.
voice_effects.field.name: Name
voice_effects.section.sample_hint: Optional. When set, this sample replaces the NPC's normal cloning reference whenever the effect is active.
voice_effects.stages.empty: No stages yet. Add one above to start shaping the sound.
voice_effects.stages.unknown: Unknown stage type — schema not loaded.
voice_effects.stages.speed_hint: Higher values make the voice faster; lower values make it slower.
voice_effects.confirm.delete: Delete voice effect "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
voice_effects.confirm.revert: Revert "{{name}}" to the version {{plugin}} ships? Your copy will be removed.
voice_effects.confirm.revert_builtin: Revert "{{name}}" to the built-in version? Your copy will be removed.
records.chip.builtin_tooltip: Shipped with SkyrimNet. Saving your edits creates your own copy that shadows it.
records.chip.plugin_tooltip: Shipped by {{plugin}}. Saving your edits creates your own copy that shadows it.
records.chip.override_tooltip: Your copy shadows the shipped record. Revert removes your copy and brings that one back.
records.chip.local_plugin_tooltip: In your plugin {{plugin}}. Saving edits the plugin's own file.
records.active.label: Active
records.active.on: Record active. Switch it off to ignore this record without editing or deleting it.
records.active.off: Record off: ignored as if it did not exist. Switch it on to apply it again.
records.toolbar.compare: Compare with the other copies of this file
records.unplaced_one: 1 {{root}} entry from your old settings file could not be moved and is NOT active: {{names}}. Re-create it here.
records.unplaced_other: {{count}} {{root}} entries from your old settings file could not be moved and are NOT active: {{names}}. Re-create them here.
records.error.write: The {{root}} record could not be written.
records.lists.effective_desc: Every entry the active lists below add up to, with the lists it comes from.
records.lists.heading: Lists
records.lists.desc: Each list adds its entries. Remove the built-in or plugin lists you don't want (you can restore them), and make your own with New list. Open a list to edit it or add it to a plugin to share it.
records.lists.remove_title: Stop using this list. It moves to Removed, where you can restore it.
records.lists.name: Name
records.lists.delete_confirm: Delete the list {{name}}? Nothing will be left in its place.
records.lists.revert_confirm: Remove your copy of {{name}} and use the one {{plugin}} ships again?
records.lists.removed: List removed. Restore it from Removed.
action_library.page_desc: Manage action configurations and view per-actor eligibility states.
action_library.filter.search_placeholder: Search by name, description, plugin, or author…
action_library.empty: No actions match the current filters.
action_library.actors.heading: Nearby Actors
action_library.actors.placeholder_body: Select an actor on the left to view their action eligibility.
action_library.actors.failure_heading: Why this action is not eligible:
action_library.actors.failure_both: Both action eligibility and tag requirements failed
action_library.tags.heading: Registered Tags ({{n}})
action_library.tags.readonly_body: Tags are managed through code registration (e.g. in skynet_Library.psc). This view shows currently registered tags and their eligibility functions.
